values.body_text: Qinghe Alternative Residence contract draft: monthly rent CNY 7000, one-month deposit plus one-month rent, and a platform service fee of CNY 500. The reservation payment refund conditions are incomplete. Repair service promises a response within two business days; fee responsibility and seepage responsibility require a repair attachment. The payment account must be a corporate account of the contracting party. The property owner's identity card and authorization attachment remain pending. Do not send materials or pay fees before signing; confirm each item first.
